title: Concept: Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy value without cross-origin isolation
description: Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy is present but carries a value that does not isolate the browsing context: only same-origin (or same-origin-allow-popups where popups are intended) severs the window.opener relationship. The rule reports the non-isolating value; the reviewer decides which of the two is intended.
risk: A window opened by a hostile page keeps its opener handle and can be navigated or measured through window.opener, and the document cannot opt into cross-origin isolation; MEDIUM severity because the impact depends on which sensitive pages an attacker can open in a new window.
